note: Fan-made character reference for an unofficial tribute game. Bluey is created by Joe Brumm and made by Ludo Studio for ABC Kids / BBC Studios. No official art or audio is used here.

characters.name: Bluey
characters.personality: Boundless imagination, bossy in the nicest way, never runs out of ideas for a game.
characters.funFact: Almost every episode starts because Bluey has invented a brand new game — and everyone has to play their part properly.

characters.name: Bingo
characters.personality: Gentle, thoughtful and quietly brave. Feels big feelings and says the wisest things.
characters.funFact: Bingo's catch-cry is a tiny, world-changing word: "Wackadoo!"

characters.name: Bandit
characters.personality: An archaeologist who digs up bones by day and is dragged into every game by night. Says yes far more often than he should.
characters.funFact: Dr Bandit Heeler, PhD — the only dad who will play 'Shadowlands' on a hot footpath in bare feet.

characters.name: Chilli
characters.personality: Warm, funny, endlessly patient — and the best at knowing exactly what a kid actually needs.
characters.funFact: Chilli works in airport security, which means nothing gets past her at home either.

characters.name: Muffin
characters.personality: A tiny hurricane of pure want. Absolutely certain she is right about everything.
characters.funFact: "I'm a big girl now!" — Muffin, mid-meltdown, wearing a nappy on her head.

characters.name: Socks
characters.personality: Went through a long and committed phase of being a dog. Which, technically, she is.
characters.funFact: Socks spent most of a season walking on all fours and barking — then said her first proper sentence and everyone cheered.

characters.name: Uncle Stripe
characters.role: Bandit's younger brother, dad to Muffin and Socks
characters.personality: Loud, competitive and deeply loving. Loses to his own children constantly.
characters.funFact: Stripe grew up wrestling Bandit for the good spot on the couch. Nothing has changed.

characters.name: Aunt Trixie
characters.role: Stripe's wife, mum to Muffin and Socks
characters.personality: Cheerful, unbothered, and completely unfazed by her two chaotic daughters.
characters.funFact: Trixie can carry a conversation, a handbag and a screaming Muffin at the same time.

characters.name: Nana Chris
characters.role: Bandit's mum — Bluey and Bingo's nana
characters.personality: Sweet and proper, until there's a dance floor or a floor-mopping competition.
characters.funFact: The girls once dressed up as 'Grannies' named Janet and Rita just to floss-dance like Nana.

characters.name: Grandad Bob
characters.personality: Stubborn as a fence post, soft as a marshmallow underneath.
characters.funFact: Bob is not supposed to be doing that. Bob is doing it anyway.

characters.name: Lucky
characters.personality: Easy-going, up for anything, always appearing over the back fence at the right moment.
characters.funFact: Lucky's dad is the reigning champion of over-the-fence cricket commentary.

characters.name: Judo
characters.personality: Bold, a bit of a rule-bender, brilliant at sleepover games.
characters.funFact: Judo's mum is Wendy, who lives next door and always has a spare thing you need.

characters.name: Honey
characters.personality: Shy, kind and quietly determined. Wears glasses and notices everything.
characters.funFact: Honey is the friend who patiently waits her turn — and then absolutely nails it.

characters.name: Coco
characters.personality: Enthusiastic, a little bit dramatic, tries very hard to keep up with everyone.
characters.funFact: Coco will happily change the rules of a game mid-play if it means she gets to join in.

characters.name: Snickers
characters.personality: Sweet and literal, and very aware that his body is longer than everyone else's.
characters.funFact: Snickers' long back is either a superpower or a serious problem, depending on the game.

characters.name: Chloe
characters.personality: Thoughtful and grounded — the friend who asks the question everyone was thinking.
characters.funFact: Chloe's dad taught her a game about noticing tiny things on a very ordinary walk.

characters.name: Mackenzie
characters.personality: Fast, focused and fiercely loyal. A New Zealander with a big heart.
characters.funFact: Mackenzie can herd an entire class of puppies without anyone realising it happened.

characters.name: Rusty
characters.personality: Sporty, generous and unstoppable — cricket bat permanently in hand.
characters.funFact: Rusty's dad is in the army, and Rusty is the best at making up backyard cricket rules.

characters.name: Indy
characters.personality: Free-spirited, imaginative and very in tune with nature.
characters.funFact: Indy's mum keeps a very organic house, so Indy's snacks are... interesting.

characters.name: Winton
characters.personality: Serious, a bit posh, takes the rules of any game extremely seriously.
characters.funFact: Winton has strong opinions about the correct way to play, and he will share them.

characters.name: Jean-Luc
characters.personality: Quiet, kind and adventurous. Speaks French and plays a mean game of chasey.
characters.funFact: Bluey met Jean-Luc on holiday — proof that you don't need the same language to play the same game.

characters.name: Calypso
characters.personality: Calm, wise and endlessly gentle. Lets children solve things themselves.
characters.funFact: Calypso's answer to almost everything is a soft chime and a bit of patience.

characters.name: Frisky
characters.role: Chilli's friend, later Uncle Rad's partner
characters.personality: Bubbly, fun and the world's most enthusiastic babysitter.
characters.funFact: Frisky once wore Bluey's swimming goggles to a very fancy occasion.

characters.name: Uncle Rad
characters.personality: Laid-back to the point of horizontal, drifts off mid-sentence, deeply fond of his nieces.
characters.funFact: Rad works away a lot, so his visits are treated like a public holiday.

characters.name: Chattermax
characters.personality: Relentlessly cheerful. Cannot be switched off. Ever.
characters.funFact: Bandit once tried to hide Chattermax on top of the fridge. It did not work.
